name: Robotic Surgery Gesture Dataset
description: A dataset and benchmark suite for segmentation and recognition of surgical gestures in robotic surgery video.
reputation: A standard academic benchmark for surgical gesture segmentation/recognition with moderate use in the medical-vision research community.
notes: Small, domain-specific dataset(s) with inter-annotator variability and lab-controlled conditions; commonly used in non-LLM, computer-vision research on temporal segmentation and recognition.
